`const` prevents reassignment of the binding, not mutation of the object itself. Your code doesn't throw because `config.retries = 5` mutates the object—it doesn't reassign `config`. 

Reassigning the binding would throw:
```javascript
config = { retries: 6 };  // TypeError
```

To prevent property mutation, you'd need `Object.freeze(config)`, which would make `config.retries = 5` throw in strict mode.
